snippet.title: Catacrypt - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Watch a small gameplay teaser for my upcoming game Catacrypt. Catacrypt is a 4-player co-op dungeon crawler, rougelite that is being released on Steam for PC. In this game, you and your friends pick your class and travel to procedurally generated dungeons and try to see how many floors you can complete. Craft items and collect upgrades from chests. The further you go down, the more enemies appear and the stronger they become. Each floor resets the generation, with more unique room layouts being unlocked at later floors.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4849580/Catacrypt/
